# Wara Alam Shah

Wara Alam Shah واڑہ عالم شاہ is a village and union council (administrative subdivision) of Mandi Bahauddin District in the Punjab province of Pakistan.
Amjad Alam Khan, the founder of Wara Alam Shah, who settled the village. The history of this village is known from an elder that this village came into existence about four hundred years ago. It is located at 32°30'30N 73°16'50E.
